posts.cooked:
My guesses is that the Heroes of Vengeance will all have direct nemeses or connections with previous expansions, in keeping with the theme that this is expansion is all about the villains striking back.  I'm thinking that all of these heroes will have experienced suffering at the hands of a villain, or be reformed villains themselves. In addition, since this is being sold as a stand-alon game (as well as expansion to the base), I'll give my best guess as to the "roles" that they will fulfill.

 

Mainstay- With the F5 being plagued by Baron Blade and his team of like-minded miscreants, the world is goingto need a new hero team to take up the slack.  After all, Evil never rests and the other villains certainly aren't going to stop their malevolence.  Luckily, the Prime wardens can step up.  

Best guess as to role- Leader.  I'm thinking he's going to be all about a mixed bag of support and tanking. My guess is that he's less about taking the hits for everyone and more about being at the center of the action. Legacy is the king of defensive leadership and making everyone stronger- I'm thinking that Mainstay is going to be about making everyone more flexible...

 

Twitchy- while it is entirely possible that his powers are luck based, the cube on his chest could simply indicate that he works as a Bounty Hunter for FILTER and the block.  

Best guess as to Role- Villain lockdown.  I'm thinking that Twitchy is the go-to character for totally occupying a villain target.  He'll go after them one at a time, making sure that they can't do anything to anyone except him.  

 

Giganto-Thorathian- If Voss's own people kicked him out, they've obviously got one or two good-hearted (or heart equivalent) people among them.  Maybe she's on of the ones he experimented on, or maybe her heart (or heart equivalent) hungers to redeem her people in the eyes of a planet that has seen only their worst villain.

Role- I'm thinking pure tank.  some damage, but mostly buckets of HP and damage prevention.  Possibly enviro/ongoing manipulation- given her size, I'm thinking that she could do a lot to influence how the environment acts upon the heroes (think about how many environments would be a non-issue to a giant!)

 

The Hacktivist- Miss Information is all about controlling the flow of events from behind the scenes, so it seems like her nemesis would be someone actively trying to track her down.  Best guess is (as was stated several posts ago) a tech-savvy detective type and hacker, going out and about to track down information and influence events.

Role- Support.  I'm guessing that we're going to see a lot of equipment/device manipulation, deck building, and redirection.  I'm thinking that he'll be able to "upgrade" either his own equipment or other hero's stuff.

 

5th hero?  Possibly metalmouth or the android-looking guy on shock rounds.   Maybe a survivor of Spite's killing spree.  Maybe an Agent of FILTER.  Heck, maybe it will be a repentant Citizen Dusk, or the team of oddballs from Chrono-ranger's "the whole gang" bounty.

I'm thinking someone who is (mostly) a pure damage dealer, though in a different direction from Ra.

posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
When did we find out the AA was the leader fo the Prime Wardens?

As for Con... let me metagame, for a moment.

Each of the expansions has been about a central theme.  Rook city was the dark/gritty expansion.  Relics was about magic and the mystical side of things.  Shattered timelines was about the darkest futures, and how they could happen.

 

What is Vengeance going to be about?  While on the surface its about a villain team, and the moment for the villains to take front stage, I'm thinking that the root theme is change.

 

At a gameplay level it defines a new way of playing the game.  It is a standalone type of game, as opposed to the standard expansion.  Plotwise, I suspect we're going to see some major, major changes for the heroes.  This may well be when we see which Legacy survives.

In terms of the heroes, I think that they are going to be extensions of that theme.  We're going to see heroes who fit with the theme of change.  So- heroes who used to be villains, heroes who are radically different mechanically, or heroes who hint at entirely new sides/agendas in the sentinels conflict.

 

Con may well fit that description, but something tells me that we're going to see a very science/tech heavy expansion soon.  I'm guessing thats when we'll finally see Unity and AZ's individual nemeses (I'm counting the V5 as a group nemesis).  If Con is an AI, or (as some have suggested) a future AI fusion of Unity/Fixer, then the superscience time is when to let it step up and make a grand entrance. Not when we've got a HUGE mess of plotlines coming together.  Especially when we don't know/trust Con!  

All we know is that it's managed to exist for a very long time, and it has a vested interest in eliminating key targets in history.  to me, that sounds like the action of someone who is trying desperately to undo some key thing....but here's the reason I don't think Vengeance is the time for Con.  NONE of the bounties are for the key players of the V5- they are people who we haven't met yet, or are tangential to the plot (like Ambuscade).
